requirements.verifier_assertion: test_valid_docx / _open_doc: a valid, non-empty .docx must exist at /workspace/report.docx (OUTPUT_PATH).
L2 code judge (_find_code_file) reads /workspace/generated_code.py and scores it; it must be the actual runnable script that reads the Excel and produces the docx.
must_include: runnable code that reads the Excel input

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_page_dimensions: page width 21.0cm and height 29.7cm (A4), within 0.1cm.
test_page_margins: top/bottom margins 2.54cm and left/right margins 3.0cm, at least 3 of 4 within 0.1cm.
test_body_font: Normal style font name contains 'FangSong' and size is 12pt (within 1pt).
test_heading_formatting: level-1 16pt bold center, level-2 14pt bold left, level-3 12pt bold left.
test_paragraph_formatting: body paragraphs use 1.5x line spacing and a ~24pt first-line indent.
test_table_present: at least 3 tables, at least one with >=5 rows and >=2 columns, and a bold header row.
must_include: at least 2 columns (Item, Amount) and at least 8 rows
at least 2 columns (Item, Value) and at least 6 rows

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_chart_embedded: at least one inline image (the matplotlib cash-flow chart) embedded in the document.
test_content_structure: at least 3 of the known section headings appear in the document text.
L2/L3 judges + Section 4 requirement: multi-period cash-flow table from IRR_Returns rows 21-30, required row labels, >=6 columns and >=5 rows.
must_include: Initial Investment, Cash Interest, Repayment, Principal, and Participation on Exit
at least 6 columns (row label + 5 periods) and at least 5 rows

requirements.verifier_assertion: L2/L3 judges + Section 2 requirement: deal-structure table extracted from the Input sheet with the required rows.
L2/L3 judges + Section 3 requirement: debt-terms table from the Input sheet with the required rows.
must_include: maturity years, annual repayment, coupon rate

requirements.verifier_assertion: Formatting requirement / judges: amounts to 2 decimals (in thousands), percentages to 2 decimals.
must_include: amounts to 2 decimal places (in thousands), percentages to 2 decimal places

requirements.verifier_assertion: Formatting requirement / judges: page numbers present in the footer.
Section 1 requirement: the report states the IRR return conclusion from the IRR_Returns tab.
Section 5 requirement: exit year 2018, exit-method assumptions, IRR factors, risk factors.
must_include: exit timing, exit multiples, debt-repayment schedule

requirements.verifier_assertion: Environment constraint: network is not required and should not be used; use the pre-installed libraries.
must_include: Network access is not required and should not be used
